name: Living History Fusilier

intro.text: Attention! I am a Royal Inniskilling Fusilier of 1815, on my way to Waterloo. Also, a dentist from Lisnaskea. Have at you!

win: Stand at ease. Then sit down. My boots are pinching.
after: The real Skins marched with pipes and drums. I march with a flask of tea. History is about adapting.
